actions.add_user_to_group.description: Add a user key as a member of a Pushover delivery group
actions.add_user_to_group.props.device.d: Limit group deliveries to this one device of the user. All of their devices receive them when omitted.
actions.add_user_to_group.props.group_ke: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.
actions.add_user_to_group.props.memo.des: Note stored with the membership, maximum 200 characters, for example Primary on-call.
actions.add_user_to_group.props.user.des: The 30-character user key of the person to add.
actions.assign_license.description: Spend a prepaid credit to license a Pushover user
actions.assign_license.props.email.descr: Pushover account email of the person to license, used when their user key is unknown. Supply either this or User Key, not both.
actions.assign_license.props.os.descript: Restrict the license to one platform. Any platform may be used when omitted.
actions.assign_license.props.user.descri: The 30-character user key to license. Supply either this or Email, not both.
actions.cancel_emergency_retries.descrip: Stop the retry loop of one emergency notification receipt
actions.cancel_emergency_retries.props.r: Receipt id returned by Send Push Message at emergency priority (2).
Stop the retry loops of every emergency notification carrying a tag
A single tag that was supplied in the Tags parameter at send time, for example deploy. One tag only, with no spaces or slashes.
actions.create_delivery_group.descriptio: Create a Pushover delivery group, or return the existing one with that name
actions.create_delivery_group.props.name: Name of the delivery group, for example On-Call Engineers. Matching against existing groups ignores case, and the name is returned exactly as Pushover stores it.
Name
actions.disable_group_user.description: Temporarily stop a group member from receiving group messages
actions.disable_group_user.props.group_k: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.
actions.disable_group_user.props.user.de: The 30-character user key of the member to suspend. Confirm membership with Get Delivery Group first.
actions.enable_group_user.description: Resume group deliveries to a suspended group member
actions.enable_group_user.props.group_ke: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.
actions.enable_group_user.props.user.des: The 30-character user key of the suspended member. Confirm membership with Get Delivery Group first.
actions.get_app_limits.description: Read the monthly message allowance and remaining quota of the application
actions.get_delivery_group.description: Read the name and members of one Pushover delivery group
actions.get_delivery_group.props.group_k: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups; this is not the user key stored on the connection.
actions.get_license_credits.description: Read how many prepaid Pushover license credits remain
actions.get_receipt_status.description: Read the acknowledgement status of an emergency notification receipt
actions.get_receipt_status.props.receipt: Receipt id returned by Send Push Message at emergency priority, for example rXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX.
actions.list_delivery_groups.description: List the delivery groups owned by the Pushover account
actions.list_notification_sounds.descrip: List the notification sound identifiers Pushover accepts
actions.migrate_user_to_subscription.des: Convert an existing user key into a subscribed user key
actions.migrate_user_to_subscription.pro: Migrate only this one device of the user instead of the whole account.
Default sound to set on the migrated subscription. Resolve an identifier with List Notification Sounds.
The subscription code shown on the Pushover subscription page, for example sABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.
The existing 30-character user key to migrate. Defaults to the key stored on the connection when left blank.
actions.remove_user_from_group.descripti: Permanently remove a member from a Pushover delivery group
actions.remove_user_from_group.props.gro: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.
actions.remove_user_from_group.props.use: The 30-character user key of the member to remove. Confirm membership with Get Delivery Group first.
actions.rename_delivery_group.descriptio: Change the name of a Pushover delivery group
actions.rename_delivery_group.props.grou: The 30-character delivery group key. Resolve it with List Delivery Groups.
actions.rename_delivery_group.props.name: The new group name, for example Weekend On-Call.
New Name
actions.send_notification.description: Send a push notification to a Pushover user or group.
actions.send_notification.props.device.d: Send only to this device instead of all. Separate several with commas.
actions.send_notification.props.emergenc: The two fields below apply only at priority 2, which repeats the alert until it is acknowledged. Both are then required.
actions.send_notification.props.html.des: Render <b>, <i>, <u> and <a href> tags in the message.
The notification text, up to 1024 characters.
actions.send_notification.props.priority: -2 no alert, -1 quiet, 0 normal, 1 high, 2 emergency.
actions.send_notification.props.recipien: Sent to the user or group key on your Pushover connection.
actions.send_notification.props.timestam: Unix time in seconds to show instead of the time it was sent.
actions.send_notification.props.title.de: Shown above the message. Empty uses your app name.
actions.send_notification.props.url.desc: A link shown under the message.
actions.send_notification.props.url_titl: Text shown instead of the URL.
actions.send_push_message.description: Send a push message through Pushover with the full parameter set
actions.send_push_message.props.attachme: Base64-encoded image to attach, maximum 5242880 bytes decoded. Requires Attachment Type.
MIME type of the attachment, for example 'image/jpeg'. Required when an attachment is supplied.
actions.send_push_message.props.callback: Emergency priority only. Pushover POSTs to this URL once the notification is acknowledged.
actions.send_push_message.props.device.d: Deliver only to this device name, for example 'iphone'. All devices receive it when omitted.
actions.send_push_message.props.expire.d: Emergency priority only. Seconds to keep retrying for, maximum 10800.
actions.send_push_message.props.html.des: Parse a limited HTML subset in the message. Cannot be combined with Monospace.
actions.send_push_message.props.monospac: Render the message in a monospace font. Cannot be combined with Enable HTML.
actions.send_push_message.props.priority: Delivery urgency. 2 (emergency) additionally requires Retry and Expire, ignores Time To Live, and returns a receipt.
actions.send_push_message.props.retry.de: Emergency priority only. Seconds between repeat deliveries, minimum 30. Pushover stops after 50 retries even if Expire has not elapsed.
actions.send_push_message.props.sound.de: Notification sound. Leave on the default option to omit the parameter so the recipient device sound applies.
actions.send_push_message.props.tags.des: Comma-separated tags stored with an emergency notification, for example 'deploy,prod'. Required upfront if you intend to use Cancel Emergency Retries by Tag.
actions.send_push_message.props.timestam: Unix timestamp to display instead of the receive time, for example '1767225600'.
actions.send_push_message.props.title.de: Title shown above the message. Defaults to the application name when omitted.
actions.send_push_message.props.ttl.desc: Seconds after which the notification is auto-deleted from the device. Ignored at emergency priority (2).
actions.send_push_message.props.url.desc: Supplementary URL shown with the message, for example 'https://status.example.com/incident/42'.
actions.send_push_message.props.url_titl: Link text for the supplementary URL. The raw URL is shown when omitted.
actions.update_glance.description: Update the Pushover glance widget fields on the user devices
actions.update_glance.props.count.descri: Integer shown on the widget, may be negative. Omit to leave unchanged.
actions.update_glance.props.device.descr: Update only this device name. All devices are updated when omitted.
actions.update_glance.props.percent.desc: Integer from 0 to 100 rendered as a progress bar. Omit to leave unchanged.
actions.update_glance.props.subtext.desc: Second line of text, maximum 100 characters. Omit to leave unchanged. Values cannot be cleared once set.
actions.update_glance.props.text.descrip: Main line of text, maximum 100 characters. Omit to leave unchanged. Values cannot be cleared once set.
actions.update_glance.props.title.descri: Short description of the data, maximum 100 characters. Omit to leave unchanged. Values cannot be cleared once set.
actions.validate_user_key.description: Check whether a Pushover user or group key is valid and reachable
actions.validate_user_key.props.device.d: Optional device name to validate alongside the key, for example iphone.
actions.validate_user_key.props.user.des: The 30-character user or group key to validate. Defaults to the key stored on the connection when left blank.
auth.description:
To connect Pushover:

1. Log in at [pushover.net](https://pushover.net).
2. Copy **Your User Key** from the top of the page.
3. Under **Your Applications**, open your app or click **Create an Application/API Token**, then copy its **API Token/Key**.

To notify a group instead, paste its group key as the User Key.
auth.props.api_token.description: The API Token/Key of your Pushover application.
auth.props.user_key.description: Your user key, or a group key to notify a group.
